photos.file: Quebrada Santo Domingo fieldwork (La Rioja, Argentina).jpg
photos.desc: Research team at the Quebrada Santo Domingo site (outcrops of the Santo Domingo Formation in La Rioja Province, Argentina), where the fossils of the dinosaur Huayracursor jaguensis were found.
Holotype specimen (CRILAR-Pv 151) of Huayracursor jaguensis , a long-necked dinosaur that lived approximately 230 million years ago, placed in approximate anatomical articulation.
Martín Hechenleitner (CRILAR-CONICET) preparing the skeleton of Huayracursor jaguensis for analysis.
Excavation of Huayracursor jaguensis in 2018. From left to right: Lucas Fiorelli (CRILAR-CONICET), Martín Hechenleitner (CRILAR-CONICET) and Léa Leuzinger.
